payload.text: Issue 0672 (high) rides 3.3.0 (decision 109). vc's rulings under the pen on 2026-11-10, each open to hv's reversal: it is built in the full shape, sized M in the issue, where the build and test lines are rendered from what the project declares, `bin/devbin` where the tree has one, else declared commands, else none; and ic builds it and vc judges. It was cc's until vc moved it the same day, before any session had read the order, to shorten cc's lane. A fix reaches a project at the 3.3.0 cut and that project's next agents sync, because brew's intent renders AGENTS.md from its keg. The instruments that re-measure the fleet against a build are refs/bank/vc/0672/survey-swift.zsh, survey-shell-tests.zsh and survey-imports.zsh.
